title: betterlite agents
description: Which CLI and model plays each role, how a run is started, and the limits the dispatcher enforces.

worktrees.description: Directory for task worktrees, relative to the repository root.

OutputMode.description: file: the runner writes its final JSON answer to {output}. claude-json: stdout is Claude's JSON result and the answer is its structured_output.

limit_retry_minutes.description: Minutes a vendor stays skipped after one of its runs hit the usage limit. The next run after that tries it again.

max_blocked_reports.description: Blocked reports in a row before a task goes back to the architect instead of climbing to the next rung.

max_hook_blocks.description: Times the Stop hook sends an agent back before it lets the run end red.

max_parallel.description: Runs at once on each vendor that sets no max_parallel of its own. A run waits for a free seat.

max_review_rounds.description: Review rounds before a task goes back to the architect.

max_worker_attempts.description: Worker attempts across the whole ladder. A run that hits a usage limit doesn't count, so skipped rungs leave their attempts to the rungs after them.

review_by_other_vendor.description: The reviewer runs on a different vendor than the worker whose change it reads. When every such reviewer is at its usage limit, one on the worker's vendor runs.

writable.description: Folders a worker may write besides its worktree, like the repository's .git folder and tool caches. {git_common_dir} and {home} expand.

instructions.description: The role's rules file, relative to .development/.

ladder.description: Rungs tried in order. The dispatcher climbs to the next rung when a rung's attempts run out, and skips a rung whose vendor is at its usage limit.

security_reviewer.description: Reviews tasks whose review_level is security.

Runner.description: How to start one agent run. The prompt goes to stdin. Arguments may use {model}, {effort}, {worktree}, {schema}, {schema_text}, {output}, {instructions}, {git_common_dir}, {home}, {writable_roots} (the policy's writable folders as a TOML array) and {sandbox_settings} (a Claude settings file that sandboxes Bash to the worktree and those folders).

vendor.description: The id of the vendor whose account runs this CLI.

Vendor.description: An account that runs agents. Each runner names one, so a new CLI is one vendor and its runners.

limit_markers.description: Text the vendor's CLI prints when the account is out of usage. A run that ends without an answer and prints one in its last lines marks the vendor, and every ladder skips it for limit_retry_minutes.

max_parallel.description: Runs at once on this vendor. Without it the policy's max_parallel applies.
